arguments.query: SELECT status, count(*), min(order_ts), max(order_ts) FROM orders GROUP BY status
SELECT o.order_ts, p.paid_ts FROM orders o JOIN payments p USING(order_id) LIMIT 5
SELECT payment_status, method, count(*), sum(amount_twd) FROM payments GROUP BY 1,2
SELECT o.status, p.payment_status, count(*) FROM orders o LEFT JOIN payments p USING(order_id) GROUP BY 1,2
SELECT o.status, count(s.order_id), sum(s.delivered_ts is not null) FROM orders o LEFT JOIN shipments s USING(order_id) GROUP BY 1
SELECT o.status, count(DISTINCT r.order_id) FROM orders o JOIN refunds r USING(order_id) GROUP BY 1
SELECT i.unit_price_cents/p.list_price_twd, count(*) FROM order_items i JOIN products p USING(product_id) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 8
SELECT count(*), count(DISTINCT order_id) FROM payments

WITH it AS (SELECT order_id, sum(quantity*unit_price_cents)/100.0 v FROM order_items GROUP BY 1), pk AS (SELECT order_id, sum(amount_twd) a, count(*) n FROM payments WHERE payment_status='ok' GROUP BY 1) SELECT o.status, count(*), sum(it.v), sum(pk.a), sum(abs(it.v-pk.a)<0.5), sum(pk.n>1) FROM orders o JOIN it USING(order_id) LEFT JOIN pk USING(order_id) WHERE o.order_ts LIKE '2025-11%' GROUP BY 1
SELECT count(*), sum(refund_amount_twd) FROM refunds WHERE refund_ts LIKE '2025-11%'
SELECT sum(r.refund_amount_twd) FROM refunds r JOIN orders o USING(order_id) WHERE o.order_ts LIKE '2025-11%'
SELECT count(*), sum(i.refund_amount_twd) FROM refunds i JOIN order_items t USING(item_id) WHERE i.refund_amount_twd > t.quantity*t.unit_price_cents/100.0
